Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: coherent 4-frame walking animation sprite sheet for Three Kingdoms game. Image 1 is CHARACTER IDENTITY AND STYLE reference. Draw a NEW 4-column by 3-row atlas, 12 complete isolated poses, every cell exactly square, overall 4:3 canvas at least 2560x1920. This is a traditional 2D animator's WALK CYCLE sheet. Use the exact same head, body, costume, palette and weapon shapes in all 4 frames within each row; keep camera pure RIGHT-FACING SIDE VIEW and the head and waist at nearly identical positions. Row 1 is Liu Bei: frightened man in pale green Chinese robe, topknot, green trousers and dark boots, anxious running arms. Row 2 ordinary Cao soldier: grey metal helmet with red plume, dark armor with red cloth, single sword held consistently forward. Row 3 heavy Cao soldier: stocky dark metal plate armor, gray helmet with red plume, black beard, round wooden shield on near arm and sword in far hand. Reference identifies these characters (top-left Liu Bei, lower middle sword soldier, lower third shield soldier). ALL THREE ROWS perform the SAME exact sequence across four columns: COL1 near-side/right leg reaches FORWARD to the RIGHT, heel contacting ground, far-side/left leg stretches BACK to the LEFT. COL2 near-side/right leg now planted UNDER hip, far-side/left knee lifts FORWARD toward right, sole off ground. COL3 far-side/left leg extends FORWARD to right heel contact, near-side/right leg extends BACK to left, a clearly different swapped stance from column1. COL4 far-side/left leg planted UNDER hip, near-side/right knee lifts FORWARD toward right. Then loop COL1. Keep near-side leg brighter and clearly layered IN FRONT; far-side leg slightly darker and behind so viewers can see alternating anatomical legs. Two legs and two feet only per frame, no extra limbs, no missing feet, NO pasted or sliced legs, NO mirror-flipping the whole character. Frame 1 and 3 must show opposite legs forward. Frames 2 and 4 show opposite knees raised. Feet stay near 94% of each cell's height; body heights consistent. Entire character and weapon fit within each cell with a clean gutter. Crisp refined ink linework, cute expressive ancient Chinese comic style, faithful to reference. BACKGROUND ONLY pure flat bright magenta RGB(255,0,255) #FF00FF, INCLUDING HOLES between legs, matching uniform color all 12 cells, no shadows. This is intentional chroma key background, NOT transparent. NO checkerboard, no gray pattern, no labels, no numbers, no text, no cell dividers, no floor or scenery. Do not let the red costume become magenta; characters retain reference colors.
